question: With what materials should worship be performed before proceeding to the next practice?
premises: Worship is to be completed first.
Fragrance, flowers, and unbroken rice are used.
Other similar materials may also be included.
inference: One should first worship using fragrance, flowers, unbroken rice, and similar materials.
plain_english: Having worshipped with fragrance, flowers, unbroken rice, and so on.
